text: The subadvisory route leaves a regulatory gap: none of the mutual fund manager's obligations, such as daily valuation, public and SEC reporting, or independent boards, reach the private fund adviser serving as subadviser.
citation: Kaal, Confluence of Mutual and Private Funds (2016). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2715083

isBasedOn.name: Confluence of Mutual and Private Funds

abstract: none of the mutual fund manager's regulatory obligations (such as daily valuation, public/SEC reporting, independent boards, etc.) apply to the private fund subadviser.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: private fund managers subadvising a mutual fund, subfund, or account
